name: 37160 · Shelbyville, TN
findings: ZIP 37160 (Shelbyville) has 79 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37160 (Shelbyville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 37160 (Shelbyville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).
